# Bundled geometry library

`polygon-clipping.umd.min.js` is the unmodified polygon-clipping 0.15.7 UMD bundle from the official npm package, verified against its published SHA-512 integrity value.

- Source: https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping/tree/v0.15.7
- Bundle SHA-256: `7f8619e84a86ce8dd400c9b50430e9c8cf8f26027b19eeb479f109f5c1a9d688`
- polygon-clipping: MIT; see `polygon-clipping-LICENSE.md`.
- Bundled splaytree 3.1.2: MIT; see `splaytree-LICENSE.txt`. Its author and license notice remain in the bundle.
- Bundled robust-predicates: Unlicense; see `robust-predicates-LICENSE.txt`.
- Generated TypeScript runtime helpers retain their Microsoft copyright and Apache 2.0 notice; see `Apache-2.0.txt`.

The offline packager embeds these license texts alongside the bundled script.
